title: Add localStorage persistence for uploaded data across tabs
acceptance_criteria: Inspector tab: result and file metadata persist across tab switches
Batch tab: batch items persist across tab switches
Text tab: text items and analysis results persist across tab switches
Simulator tab: source file and results persist across tab switches
Diff tab: both slots persist across tab switches
Playground tab: rules and results persist across tab switches
Data is serialized as JSON (no File objects - store name/size/type/metadata)
Persistence uses key prefix 'watermark-' to avoid collisions
Max storage size check with warning at ~4MB
deliverables: src/App.tsx (all view components updated to use persistence)
